solutionSql:
SELECT r.id AS route_id,
       w.city AS destination_city
FROM routes r
LEFT JOIN warehouses w ON w.id = r.destination_id
ORDER BY r.id;
notes: Routes join to warehouses on destination_id. Every route resolves to a city, and the LEFT JOIN keeps all six routes. Routes 1 and 5 both end in Mossreach, which is correct for the duplicated lane.
